purpose: All304 runtime frame slots are procedurally rendered from pinned genuine high-resolution textures. Not304 new hand-drawn frames, not neural upscaling and not an approved art replacement.

method.measuredInputs: Per-frame original256 alpha bbox and upper ear centroids, bounded relative to each action median. Original16 high-resolution action textures supply every colour sample; new16 mood drawings supply emotion texture keys.
method.temporalLimits: Continuous mechanical deformation between explicit high-resolution texture keys. No crossfade/double eyes. Different key drawings remain discrete, and old256 RGB/expression details are not exactly reconstructed.

output.cacheLimitScope: Three strongly-held decoded Image objects is a renderer target; browser image decode/texture caches, CSS-backed resources and transition buffers can exceed this and need runtime observation.

limitations: No new hand-drawn continuous304-frame animation. Every frame is a deterministic native-texture rig derivative.
Original16 texture source has pre-existing edge contacts in poses4/7/10/11; no missing source anatomy is painted back.
The new mood sheet has uneven native key spacing and a small surprise accent in one key; connected-body rectangular crop/registration does not certify visual approval.
The RGBA original files are byte-preserved. Only offline derived assets are rasterized; no remote inference/runtime network API.
